description: Defines the interface classes for HPACK entry decoder listeners used in HTTP/2 header decoding, including base, logging, and no-op implementations.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderListener
classes.description: Abstract base class for HPACK entry decoder event listeners, defining callback methods for header decoding events.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderVLoggingListener
classes.description: A listener that logs header decoding events before delegating to another listener.

classes.name: HpackEntryDecoderNoOpListener
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the listener interface, performing no actions on callbacks.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Called when an indexed header has been decoded.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Called when the start of a literal header (with optional name reference) has been decoded.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Called when the encoding and length of a header name have been decoded.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Called when a portion of the header name data has been decoded.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Called after the entire header name has been decoded.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Called when the encoding and length of a header value have been decoded.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Called when a portion of the header value data has been decoded.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Called after the entire header value has been decoded.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Called when a dynamic table size update has been decoded.
